title: Bob Whitsitt on (Re)Building the Seattle SuperSonics, NBA Expansion and Managing Star Players
summary: Bob Whitsitt, the winningest general manager in Seattle SuperSonics history, joins Iconic Sonics to discuss what it takes to build a successful NBA organization. title: Detlef Schrempf Has a Vision for the Sonics' Return | Shawn Kemp, Gary Payton & Seattle Basketball
summary: Detlef Schrempf joins Iconic Sonics for a wide-ranging conversation about Seattle basketball, his journey from the University of Washington to the NBA, and what it meant to return home and play for the Sonics. Detlef reflects on getting No. 22 retired at UW, legendary runs at Green Lake, becoming one of the NBA’s first international stars, and the teammates and culture that shaped Seattle’s 1990s teams. He shares stories about Shawn Kemp and Gary Payton, discusses his Hall of Fame perspective, the differences between American and international basketball development, and what a future Sonics return could mean for Seattle fans. Plus, a bonus conversation from Swinomish Casino & Lodge about sports betting in Washington.
